links.outcome: Change in LLM dry eye responses when patient race and sex varied in prompts
links.effect: Cultural sensitivity scores varied by model and demographic: Grok scored 3 for Black and Hispanic demographics, Meta AI showed minimal cultural tailoring (0.5 ± 0.5). All models recommended specialist consultation.
links.quote: Cultural sensitivity scores revealed Grok demonstrated highest awareness for minority populations (scoring 3 for Black and Hispanic demographics), while Meta AI showed minimal cultural tailoring (0.5 ± 0.5).

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM response cultural sensitivity, word count, readability, and response time across demographic prompts

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs for patient-facing dry eye information across demographic groups (equity/cultural sensitivity benchmarking) without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
